Hours not captured exactly — estimate from runtime + volume.

OpenRouter — prompt-lab phase 2 (3.1.1 data gen), 2026-07-22/23: 100-story Sonnet 4.6 pilots (v4.2 + v4.3), gpt-5.4-nano generator/judge probes, nano embodiment + recitation ablation arms (100 each), and ~9 Haiku judge passes incl. the 3-round judge-churn study. Delta on key usage counter ($15.47 total - $4.13 logged).

OpenRouter — fictional-stories 3M pilot slice (3.1.1), 2026-07-23/24: Sonnet 5 main corpus part 1 (3,000 stories incl. 367-story truncation regeneration), both gpt-5.4-nano ablation arms (3,000 each), Haiku judging of all three (~9k verdicts), nano protagonist rewrites (human + Zephyrix, 2,975 each), name-leak scrubbing, plus final prompt-lab probes (Sonnet 5 vs 4.6, Chandler attractor, rewrite iterations). Delta on key usage counter ($199.80 total - $15.47 logged).

OpenRouter — ablation-arm token parity + rewrite repairs (3.1.1), 2026-07-25: gpt-5.4-nano top-ups to 14M tokens/arm (embodiment +3,000 stories, recitation +3,300, no judging per decision), name-leak scrub ladder over the top-ups (3 nano passes; 21 constitutionally-entangled wellbeing-chunk leaks remain flagged), and Zephyrix rewrite repair passes (225 flagged -> 18).
